content:
"""
title: Image Generation Tool
description: Generate images from a text prompt using a local Stable Diffusion (Automatic1111) instance
"""

import requests
import base64
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field


class Tools:
    class Valves(BaseModel):
        A1111_BASE_URL: str = Field(
            default="http://<GAMING_PC_IP>:7860",
            description="Base URL of the Automatic1111 API",
        )
        A1111_USER: str = Field(default="greg", description="API basic auth username")
        A1111_PASSWORD: str = Field(default="", description="API basic auth password")
        IMAGE_UPLOAD_URL: str = Field(
            default="http://<GAMING_PC_IP>:8001",
            description="LAN address used internally to upload the generated image (must stay LAN-only - /save is not exposed externally)",
        )
        IMAGE_DISPLAY_URL: str = Field(
            default="https://images.yourdomain.com",
            description="Externally-reachable base URL used to build the link shown to the user",
        )

    def __init__(self):
        self.valves = self.Valves()

    def generate_image(self, prompt: str, negative_prompt: str = "") -> str:
        """
        Generate an image from a text description using Stable Diffusion.
        Use this whenever the user asks to create, draw, generate, make, or produce
        an image/picture/illustration of something.

        :param prompt: A descriptive text prompt of the image to generate.
        :param negative_prompt: Optional - things to avoid in the image.
        :return: A markdown image tag pointing to the generated image.
        """
        payload = {
            "prompt": prompt,
            "negative_prompt": negative_prompt,
            "width": 1024,
            "height": 1024,
            "steps": 20,
            "cfg_scale": 7,
            "sampler_name": "DPM++ 2M",
        }
        try:
            resp = requests.post(
                f"{self.valves.A1111_BASE_URL}/sdapi/v1/txt2img",
                json=payload,
                auth=(self.valves.A1111_USER, self.valves.A1111_PASSWORD),
                timeout=120,
            )
            resp.raise_for_status()
            image_bytes = base64.b64decode(resp.json()["images"][0])

            save = requests.post(
                f"{self.valves.IMAGE_UPLOAD_URL}/save",
                data=image_bytes,
                timeout=30,
            )
            save.raise_for_status()
            filename = save.json()["filename"]

            return f"![Generated image: {prompt}]({self.valves.IMAGE_DISPLAY_URL}/images/{filename})"
        except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
            return "Image generation timed out."
        except Exception as e:
            return f"Image generation failed: {e}"
